headline: Kassy releases 'It Hurts' MV from EP 'ODYSSEY'
sub: Opening track of a 4-song breakup story told as a sea voyage
caption:
Kassy is back with the music video for 'It Hurts' (왜 이별은 아프기만 할까요).

The song opens her EP 'ODYSSEY', four tracks that follow the journey from heartbreak to self-discovery, framed as a voyage across the sea. Kassy wrote the lyrics for all four songs. She wraps up the year with her concert 'CHAPTER.01 Farewell' on Dec 12–13 at Yonsei University's Centennial Hall in Seoul.
